user.title: How would you like to connect?

cloud.title: Sign in to iRobot
cloud.description:
Home Assistant signs in the same way the app does. It finds the login configuration automatically, then reads each robot's local key from your account — so there is no HOME-button pairing to do, and nothing to re-enter later.

Your password is stored in the config entry so sessions can be renewed on their own.

pick_robot.title: Choose a robot
pick_robot.description: Add one robot now; run the integration again to add the others.

manual_host.title: Robot not found on this network
manual_host.description: It is in your account but did not answer the discovery broadcast. Enter its IP address.

local.title: Select your robot
local.description: These robots answered the discovery broadcast on your network.

password.title: Pair with the robot
password.description: Put {host} on its dock, then press and hold the HOME button until it plays a series of tones (about two seconds). Release it and submit this form within 30 seconds.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your iRobot password
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} was rejected. Enter it again to restore cloud features.

discovery_confirm.title: {name} found
discovery_confirm.description: Found a robot at {host}. Sign in with your iRobot account to finish automatically, or pair it by hand using the HOME button.

menu_options.cloud: Sign in with my iRobot account

reconfigure.title: Change IP address
reconfigure.description: Use this if the robot moved to a different address.
